products.name: Home Made Raw Mango Pickle
products.tagline: Home Made · Made With Woodpressed Mustard Oil
products.shortDesc: Bold and authentic flavours from our kitchen to yours. Made in small batches with cold-woodpressed mustard oil and aromatic spices.
products.fullDesc: Our Home Made Raw Mango Pickle is handcrafted using hand-picked raw mangoes from sun-drenched regional orchards. We preserve each wedge in our own cold woodpressed black mustard oil, slow-aged naturally with whole fenugreek, cracked mustard seeds, rock salt, turmeric and warming spices. Zero vinegar, zero preservatives, 100% natural goodness that takes you straight back to traditional nani-dadi pickling traditions.
products.ingredients: Raw Mango, Pure Woodpressed Cold Mustard Oil, Whole Fenugreek (Methi), Mustard Seeds (Rai), Turmeric Powder, Red Chilli, Fennel Seeds (Saunf), Rock Salt, Hing (Asafoetida) & Love.
products.storageTips: Store in a cool dry place. Always use a clean dry spoon. Keep the mango pieces submerged in mustard oil for lasting freshness.
products.farmOrigin: Alphonso & Ramkela Mango Orchards, Ratnagiri & Western Ghats
products.millingProcess: Sun-dried mango slices cured in traditional earthen Martaban jars with cold woodpressed kachi ghani mustard oil.

products.name: Turmeric (Haldi) Powder
products.tagline: Stone Ground · No Additives & Preservatives · With Natural Oils
products.shortDesc: Slow stone-ground whole turmeric rhizomes rich in natural curcumin (3.5%+). Never extracted or heat treated.
products.fullDesc: Farmers Mill Turmeric is made by slowly stone-grinding carefully cured, whole Salem and Waigaon turmeric fingers on traditional stone mills. Industrial mills operate at high friction heat that evaporates delicate curcumin and volatile aromatic oils. Our low-rpm stone grinding keeps the golden natural essential oils intact, giving an intense warm aroma, rich earthy flavour, and potent natural immunity boosting qualities.
products.ingredients: 100% Pure Single-Origin Whole Turmeric (Curcuma Longa) Rhizomes. No artificial color, starch or fillers.
products.storageTips: Store in an airtight container away from direct sunlight to preserve the volatile curcumin oils.
products.farmOrigin: Erode & Waigaon Certified Organic Turmeric Farms, Maharashtra & Tamil Nadu
products.millingProcess: Traditional low-RPM stone mill grinding under 35°C, ensuring zero volatile oil loss.

products.name: Stoneground Mota Besan
products.tagline: Stone Ground · Whole Gram · Low Gluten High Fibers
products.shortDesc: Coarsely stone-milled from whole desi unpolished chana dal. Grainy texture that makes the fluffiest dhoklas and melt-in-mouth laddoos.
products.fullDesc: Unlike commercial besan which is finely pulverized from split pulse powders, our Mota Besan is coarsely ground between traditional granite millstones from premium Desi Chana (Bengal Gram). This artisanal coarse grind produces that beloved "danedar" crumb texture required for authentic Besan Ke Laddoo, Mysore Pak, crispy pakoras, Khandvi, and aromatic Kadhi without forming gluten lumps.
products.ingredients: 100% Whole Unpolished Desi Chana (Bengal Gram). Zero pea flour adulteration.
products.storageTips: Store in an airtight container in a dry pantry. Best consumed within 60 days of stone milling.
products.farmOrigin: Bikaner & Malwa Organic Gram Clusters, Rajasthan & MP
products.millingProcess: Coarse granite chakki stone ground with hull nutrients retained.

products.name: 100% Natural Honey
products.tagline: Raw & Unpasteurized · Zero Added Sugar or Corn Syrup
products.shortDesc: Unprocessed raw forest honey ethically collected by local beekeepers. Retains all natural pollen, live enzymes, and medicinal value.
products.fullDesc: Farmers Mill Raw Honey is harvested straight from forest apiaries in the pristine foothills of the Himalayas and central Indian forest reserves. It is gently filtered through organic cotton mesh to remove honeycomb wax without any heat treatment, micro-filtration, or pasteurization. Zero corn syrup, zero inverted sugar, zero artificial feed. Every spoonful crystallizes naturally in cool weather—the universal hallmark of real pure honey.
products.storageTips: Do not refrigerate. Store at room temperature away from moisture. Crystallization is a natural sign of purity; place jar in warm water to reliquify.
products.farmOrigin: Wild Forest Apiaries, Corbett Foothills & Jim Corbett Biosphere Reserve
products.millingProcess: Cold-gravity strained through natural cotton. No thermal pasteurization.

products.name: Coriander (Dhaniya) Powder
products.tagline: Stone Ground · Whole Coriander Seeds · Rich Volatile Aroma
products.shortDesc: Made from aromatic Ramganj coriander seeds with high volatile essential oil content. Fresh citrusy aroma in every pinch.
products.fullDesc: Our stoneground Dhaniya Powder is produced exclusively from unbroken, parrot-green coriander berries harvested in the famous Ramganj Mandi of Rajasthan. The whole seeds are slow-crushed at room temperature on slow-moving traditional granite stones to avoid scorching the fragrant linalool and essential oils. The result is a vibrant green-tinted fragrant powder that lends a fresh, citrusy aroma and appetizing richness to daily Indian curries.
products.ingredients: 100% Pure Whole Green Coriander (Coriandrum Sativum) Seeds. No husk or stalk dilution.
products.storageTips: Store in an airtight dark jar in a cool, moisture-free space.
products.farmOrigin: Ramganj Mandi & Hadoti Agricultural Corridor, Rajasthan
products.millingProcess: Sun-cured whole coriander seeds milled on low-temperature stone chakki.

products.name: Chakki Fresh Atta (100% MP Sharbati)
products.tagline: Stone Ground Fresh on Order · Zero Maida · 100% Whole Grain
products.shortDesc: Milled fresh on cold-grinding stone chakki hours before delivery. Ultra-soft rotis that stay tender for 12+ hours.
products.fullDesc: Commercial packaged flour sits in warehouses for months, treated with bleaching agents, artificial enzymes, and preservatives. Farmers Mill Chakki Fresh Atta is strictly milled to order on our slow-revolving heavy granite stone chakki. Because the mill stone stays below 40°C, the vital wheat germ, natural dietary fiber (bran), vitamins B & E, and wheat germ oils remain completely unharmed. Makes exceptionally fragrant, golden-hued rotis that puff up effortlessly.
products.ingredients: 100% Grade-A Sehore Sharbati Whole Wheat. 100% Bran + 100% Germ retained.
products.storageTips: Keep in a clean dry stainless steel container or the provided craft bag. Consume within 30-45 days for optimal freshness.
products.farmOrigin: Sehore & Vidisha Rainfed Black Soil Farms, Madhya Pradesh
products.millingProcess: Slow-speed natural sandstone chakki. Milled at under 40°C to preserve wheat germ.

products.name: Woodpressed Mustard Oil (Kachi Ghani)
products.tagline: Traditional Kolhu Pressed · Unrefined & Unfiltered · High Pungency
products.shortDesc: Cold-extracted in traditional wooden Kolhu (Vaagai wood) at low RPM. Distinctive golden hue, sharp pungency, and natural antioxidants.
products.fullDesc: Our Kachi Ghani Mustard Oil is pressed from selectively graded black and yellow mustard seeds in artisanal wooden presses without applying external heat or chemical solvents. Traditional woodpressing extracts oil gently below 38°C, retaining the pungency factor (sinigrin), authentic aroma, natural omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids. Unrefined, unfiltered, and rich in natural phytosterols.
products.ingredients: 100% Pure First Cold Woodpressed Black Mustard Seeds.
products.storageTips: Store in a cool dark place away from heat. Avoid direct sunlight.
products.millingProcess: Traditional wooden kolhu slow-churned extraction at room temperature.

products.name: Super-Grain Multigrain Atta
products.tagline: 7 Super Grains · Low Glycemic Index · Diabetic Friendly
products.shortDesc: A nutritionist-crafted blend of Sharbati Wheat, Ragi, Jowar, Bajra, Chana, Barley (Jau), and Roasted Flaxseeds.
products.fullDesc: Our 7-Grain Multigrain Atta provides a balanced nutritional profile designed for today's urban lifestyle. Combining whole Sharbati wheat with drought-resilient super-millets (Finger Millet, Pearl Millet, Sorghum), protein-rich desi chana, soluble-fiber rich barley, and omega-3 loaded roasted flaxseeds. Stone ground in small batches to preserve soluble dietary fiber and reduce blood sugar spikes.
products.ingredients: Whole Sharbati Wheat (60%), Desi Chana (12%), Jowar (8%), Ragi (8%), Bajra (5%), Barley/Jau (5%), Flaxseeds (2%).
products.storageTips: Store in an airtight container in a dry cool place.
products.farmOrigin: Certified Millet & Grain Collectives, Karnataka & Rajasthan
products.millingProcess: Multi-grain coarse stone milling with controlled temperature.

products.name: Mathania Red Chilli Powder
products.tagline: Sun Dried · Stone Ground · High Natural Color & Moderate Heat
products.shortDesc: Authentic Mathania chillies grown in Rajasthan. Renowned for its rich burgundy red hue and delightful, non-acrid warmth.
products.fullDesc: Mathania chilli is one of India's most prized heirloom culinary treasures. Grown exclusively in the sand dunes of Mathania village near Jodhpur, this unique chilli is famous for imparting the signature rich crimson red color to Rajasthani Lal Maas and Dal Tadka without unbearable sharp pungency. We de-stem each pod by hand, sun-dry them on raised beds, and slow stone-grind with pure stemless pods. Zero added color or Sudan red dyes.
products.ingredients: 100% Whole Stemless Heirloom Mathania Red Chillies (Capsicum Annuum).
products.storageTips: Keep tightly sealed in glass or ceramic jar away from direct sun.
products.farmOrigin: Heirloom Farms, Mathania Village, Jodhpur District, Rajasthan
products.millingProcess: Hand-stemmed and cold-ground on water-cooled stone mills.

products.name: Unpolished Indrayani Sticky Rice
products.tagline: Single Origin · Rich Natural Aroma · Unpolished Red/Brown Bran
products.shortDesc: Aromatic native paddy cultivated in the Sahyadri mountains of Maharashtra. Sticky, fragrant texture perfect for comforting khichdi & bowls.
products.fullDesc: Indrayani is an aromatic indigenous short-grain rice beloved across Western India for its sweet fragrant steam and naturally sticky, velvety texture when cooked. Unlike commercial mills that strip away 100% of the nutrient-dense aleurone layer (bran) through abrasive polishers, our rice is unpolished or semi-polished, retaining vital zinc, magnesium, and dietary fiber.
products.storageTips: Store in a cool dry bin. Add 2 dried bay leaves or neem leaves to ward off pantry weevils naturally.
products.farmOrigin: Maval & Mulshi Valleys, Pune & Sahyadri Hills, Maharashtra
products.millingProcess: Rubber-roll dehusking with 100% bran layers retained.

products.name: Sprouted Ragi (Finger Millet) Flour
products.tagline: Sprouted & Cold Stone Milled · 10x More Calcium Than Milk · Zero Gluten
products.shortDesc: Traditional sprouted finger millet (Nachni) slow stone-ground. Sprouting enhances bio-available calcium, iron, and makes it gentle on digestion.
products.fullDesc: Ragi is nature's premier calcium powerhouse. We elevate this ancient super-grain by first soaking and sprouting whole ragi berries for 36 hours. Sprouting activates digestive enzymes, neutralizes phytic acid anti-nutrients, and triples the bioavailability of calcium and iron. After sun-drying, the sprouted ragi is slowly stone-milled into a fine, aromatic mauve-colored flour that makes heavenly malt, dosas, rotis, and baby porridge.
products.ingredients: 100% Sprouted Whole Red Finger Millet (Eleusine Coracana).
products.storageTips: Store in an airtight container. Refrigeration after opening extends aroma freshness.
products.farmOrigin: Mandya Organic Millet Farmers Society, Karnataka
products.millingProcess: 36-hour germination followed by low-heat granite chakki milling.

reviews.author: Ananya Deshmukh
reviews.title: Rotis stay soft even when packed in kids lunchboxes!
reviews.comment: We switched from commercial brand atta to Farmers Mill after seeing their cold chakki process. The difference is night and day. The flour is fragrant, not stripped of bran, and the rotis stay soft till dinner time.

reviews.author: Dr. Ramesh Iyer
reviews.title: True medicinal turmeric aroma
reviews.comment: As an Ayurvedic practitioner, finding turmeric that isn’t spent root from curcumin extractors is very rare. Farmers Mill haldi leaves an oily aromatic sheen on your fingers. Truly exceptional quality.

reviews.author: Meenakshi Sundaram
reviews.title: Perfect grainy texture for Mysore Pak and Laddoos
reviews.comment: Store bought besan is like maida powder, makes laddoos sticky and pasty. This mota besan roasts with an intoxicating nutty fragrance and gives that authentic danedar bite!

reviews.author: Vikramaditya Roy
reviews.title: The authentic jhajh of real wooden kolhu mustard oil
reviews.comment: Being from Bengal, we judge mustard oil by the pungent aroma when cooking macher jhol. Modern solvent oils have zero kick. Farmers Mill woodpressed oil brought tears of joy to my grandmother. Unbelievably fresh!

reviews.author: Sunita Agarwal
reviews.title: Reminds me of my Nani’s sun-cured Martaban pickle
reviews.comment: No artificial vinegar sourness! You can taste the genuine cold-pressed mustard oil and cracked methi seeds. The raw mango wedges are firm and spicy. Finished the jar in two weeks.

reviews.author: Kavita Chawla
reviews.title: Real raw honey with pollen that isn’t boiled corn syrup
reviews.comment: Passed the warm water and NMR test without question. It has subtle floral notes of mustard bloom and wild jamun. My kids have a spoonful daily with warm water.
